title: Health and the pleasure of suffering for truth
english: Just as in the body, a person who is healthy and of good body takes pleasure even before luxury, having pleasure allotted together with health; and neither irregularities of the air, nor drought, nor cold, nor a cheap table, nor anything else of that kind could grieve such a person, since health is enough to beat away the harm from these things—so the same thing is accustomed to happen in the soul. For this reason Paul, though suffering countless terrible things, rejoiced, saying, "I rejoice in my sufferings for you..." [the quotation breaks off]—not only in the kingdom of heaven, in which a prize is set for virtue, but also in the very suffering, since this too is the greatest prize: to suffer something for the truth... [fragment breaks off]
